title: Summit Reserve Hazard Review: Projected Annual Hazard Premium
content:
For a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve under Set-Aside Accounts, the projected annual hazard premium is the figure below, worked out at each review of the reserve's hazard insurance bills.

**(1) The hazard bills of the review** are the hazard insurance bills on file for the reserve received no later than the review date and fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it.

**(2) The current hazard premium** is the billed amount of the paid hazard insurance bill with the latest due date.

**(3) The renewal hazard premium** is the current hazard premium increased once by the hazard renewal loading. The hazard renewal loading is the renewal increase of 4.0 percent plus the hazard premium-change loading, the hazard occupancy loading and the hazard appraisal loading, all in percent, added together and applied once to the current hazard premium, not one after another. The hazard premium-change loading, the hazard occupancy loading and the hazard appraisal loading are each zero.

**(4) The hazard pay-plan fee** is zero, and **the hazard renewal share** is one half (0.5).

**(5) The projected annual hazard premium** is the current hazard premium times one less the hazard renewal share, plus the renewal hazard premium times the hazard renewal share, plus the hazard pay-plan fee, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end. The review relies on the hazard insurance bill on file with the latest due date.

**Worked figures (hypothetical).** Latest-due paid hazard bill 1,800.00. Renewal hazard premium: 1,800.00 increased by 4.0 percent, 1,872.00. Projected annual hazard premium: 1,800.00 times one half plus 1,872.00 times one half, plus a zero fee: 900.00 plus 936.00, which is 1,836.00. For a latest-due paid bill of 1,234.56 the same steps give 1,234.56 plus 1,283.9424, halved: 1,259.2512, rounded once to 1,259.25.
